The BNR-MBR basins will be configured as two parallel activated sludge treatment trains, each consisting of pre-anoxic, aerobic, and post-anoxic basins in-series.
The new WRF will replace the existing WWTP with a membrane bioreactor (MBR) wastewater treatment facility that will produce tertiary treated effluent that exceeds secondary standards for discharge.

The sludge holding tanks will receive, store, and aerate activated sludge wasted from the BNR MBR process.
